question.text: If <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>0,3</mn><mo>+</mo><msqrt><mn>5</mn></msqrt></mrow></mfenced></math> is a point on the ellipse whose foci are <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>2,3</mn></mrow></mfenced></math> and <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mo>-</mo><mn>2,3</mn></mrow></mfenced></math>, then the length of the semi-major axis is

solution.text:
If P is a point on the ellipse having S & S' as foci, then

PS+P S ′ =2a
Where 2a= length of the major-axis
⇒22+5+22+5=2a
⇒a=3= semi-major axis
